login.title: Volunteer sign-in
login.text: Enter the 6-digit code you got by SMS when the City Hall created your account.
login.label: Access code
login.demo: Demo · accounts created in the City Hall panel (tap to sign in):
login.welcome: Welcome, {name}! You only see your actions.

account.createdBy: Account created by Arad City Hall

actions.title: Your actions
actions.opensAt: You can scan from {time}, 30 minutes before the start
actions.emptyText: Your coordinator assigns actions from the City Hall panel. You can write to them in Messages.

scan.title: Scan
scan.aim: Point the camera at the participant's QR code
scan.endedSub: You can no longer confirm participants here.
scan.codeHint: The code under the participant's QR, like AX-C1-…
scan.alreadySub: Confirmed by {by}{at}. Points were awarded only once.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: One chat per action, with the volunteers assigned to it.
messages.emptyText: You get a chat for each action the City Hall assigns you to.
messages.noMessages: No messages yet. Write to the other volunteers.

errors.wrongCode: Wrong code. Check the SMS or ask your coordinator.
errors.suspended: The account is suspended. Contact your coordinator.
errors.expired: The single-use account expired after the last action.
errors.tooMany: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.notAssigned: The code is for an action you are not assigned to.
errors.otherAction: The code is for another action: {title}.
errors.locked: Scanning opens 30 minutes before the start.
errors.unknownCode: Unknown code. Check the letters or ask the participant to show the code again.
errors.invalidCode: This doesn't look like an action code (AX-C…).
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.notInChat: You are not assigned to this action, so you are not in its chat.
errors.photoTooLarge: The photo is too large (max 10 MB).
errors.photoType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF photos.

panel.title: Volunteers
panel.subtitle: Only you create volunteer accounts. Volunteers use the app to scan and for the group chat of each action.
panel.kpiCoveredHint: upcoming actions with at least one volunteer
panel.suspendAsk: Suspend {name}'s account? They won't be able to sign in or scan until you reactivate it.
panel.emptyText: Create the first account: the volunteer gets a 6-digit code and scans participants in the app.
panel.drawerSub: Tick the actions where they scan.
panel.saved: Actions updated. The volunteer sees them in the app.
panel.noPublished: No published actions. Publish one from Community actions.

form.subtitle: The volunteer gets a 6-digit code by SMS and signs in with it only: sees their actions, scans and talks to the other volunteers of the action.
form.name: Name
form.oneTimeHint: Expires automatically after the last assigned action.
form.create: Create the account and send the code
form.created: Account created. Code sent by SMS (simulated): {code}
form.preview: How it looks in the app · SMS
form.smsText: Hi {name}! Arad City Hall created a volunteer account for you in AradExperience. Access code: {code}

errors.name: Write the name.
errors.phone: A valid phone number (07xx xxx xxx).
errors.email: The email address is not valid.
